primary_symptom_system.description: The primary physiological system or category associated with the patient's chief complaints and symptoms, categorized into classes like Respiratory, Gastrointestinal, Cardiovascular, Dermatological, Neurological, Musculoskeletal, or General/Constitutional.

recommended_diagnostic_type.description: The main type of diagnostic test, imaging, or examination suggested by the doctor to investigate the symptoms, categorized into classes like Laboratory Tests (blood/urine), Medical Imaging (X-ray/MRI/CT/Ultrasound), Physical/Clinical Exam, Specialized Procedures, or None.

clinical_diagnosis_category.description: The broad clinical classification of the doctor's final or provisional diagnosis conclusion, categorized into classes like Infectious Disease, Chronic/Metabolic Condition, Acute Injury/Trauma, Inflammatory/Autoimmune, Symptomatic/Undiagnosed, or Normal/Healthy.
